sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Brucebase feed: three more findings from BruceParser's full read of the wiki. ❌ a page that is no show and lacks a tag of the date in its name ("22" for a page of 1978-08-22), ⚠️ one that carries a date tag its date does not have ("23"), ⚠️ a page tagged "files" that shows no picture (30 files index pages and two venues in the run of 2026-11-15). On the cell that names the page in every Brucebase list (the "files", "news" and "media" tag pages above all), in its window, and after a venue page's byline. A show's own date tags stay with the Tags findings, so one error never gets two marks.

What the page in front of you shows wins here too: a date tag it has now, a wrong one it no longer has, a picture it shows now or a "files" tag it no longer carries drops the mark. The wiki's social icons, which every page has, are no picture. New settings: a switch for each of the three findings, on.

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: Needs the feed of BruceParser 0.19.0 on GitHub; an older feed simply has none of the three. A script before this version ignores the new data.
